brief:
Netanyahu's Likud-led bloc has risen to 52 seats in the Israeli parliament, overtaking a centrist bloc led by Gadi Eisenkot, according to Channel 12, Middle East Eye reported. The shift reflects changing dynamics ahead of elections or following recent polling.

Palestinian-led parties within Israel have gained ground, climbing to 19 seats in the latest figures. The movements signal evolving voter preferences across the political spectrum.
dek: Netanyahu's bloc overtakes Eisenkot's, as Palestinian-led parties rise to 19 seats Netanyahu's bloc has reportedly risen to 52 seats, overtaking Eisenkot's bloc, according to Israel's Channel 12. Meanwhile, Palestinian-led parties have risen to 19 seats.
title: Netanyahu's bloc gains seats as Palestinian parties rise to 19
